items.exampleEn: This knife cuts cleanly through frozen meat.
items.exampleZh: 這把刀切冷凍肉也能切得很俐落。

items.exampleEn: Her new novel is light and very readable.
My grandmother cooks simple, homely meals.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶煮的是簡單的家常菜。

items.exampleEn: He drives a showy red sports car.
items.exampleZh: 他開一輛很招搖的紅色跑車。

items.exampleEn: The sign was crudely painted on a piece of old wood.
items.exampleZh: 那塊招牌是粗糙地畫在一片舊木板上的。

items.exampleEn: The piano teacher played the opening notes staccato.
items.exampleZh: 鋼琴老師用斷奏的方式彈出開頭的幾個音。

items.exampleEn: The film's convoluted plot left many viewers confused.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影複雜曲折的情節讓許多觀眾一頭霧水。

items.exampleEn: Her eyes were a startlingly bright blue.
items.exampleZh: 她的眼睛是一種亮得驚人的藍色。

items.sentenceEn: Rain beat a staccato rhythm on the metal roof all night.
items.sentenceZh: 雨整晚在鐵皮屋頂上敲出短促斷續的節奏。

items.audioEn: The prices at the new market were startlingly low, so we filled two bags with fruit.
items.audioZh: 新市場的價格低得驚人，所以我們裝了滿滿兩袋水果。

items.sentenceEn: Large print makes the menu more readable for everyone.
items.sentenceZh: 字放大之後，菜單對每個人來說都更好讀。

items.sentenceEn: The hall was decorated in a showy style, with gold on every wall.
items.sentenceZh: 大廳裝潢得很花俏，每面牆上都是金色。

items.stemEn: The plate broke ____ into two halves, so Dad could fix it easily.
items.stemZh: 盤子乾淨俐落地裂成兩半，所以爸爸很容易就能修好。

items.stemEn: The steps for getting a refund were so ____ that nobody could follow them.
items.stemZh: 申請退款的步驟複雜到沒有人看得懂。

items.passageEn: When Amy took over her parents' small hotel, the old website was a problem. Its instructions for booking a room were so convoluted that many guests gave up in the middle. The photos were crudely cut from magazines, and the text was hardly readable on a phone. A designer suggested a showy new style with moving pictures and bright colors, but Amy wanted something homely that matched the quiet rooms. In the end, she chose simplicity: short, clear text and a few photos, cleanly arranged on a white background. The results were startlingly good, and bookings doubled within two months. Her father, who speaks in a staccato way when he is excited, kept saying, "Good. Very good. Well done."
items.passageZh: Amy 接手父母的小旅館時，舊網站是個大問題。訂房的說明複雜到很多客人做到一半就放棄了。照片是從雜誌上粗糙地剪下來的，文字在手機上幾乎無法閱讀。一位設計師建議改成有動畫、色彩鮮豔的花俏風格，但 Amy 想要的是溫馨樸實、和安靜房間相襯的感覺。最後她選擇了簡單：簡短清楚的文字加上幾張照片，乾淨俐落地排在白色背景上。結果好得驚人，兩個月內訂房就加倍了。她父親一興奮說話就會短促斷續，一直說：「好。很好。做得好。」

questions.questionZh: 舊網站原本有什麼問題？
options: 房間照片太少，看不到浴室
價格寫錯，比實際便宜很多
爸爸希望改回原本的舊網站
客人抱怨網站變得太花俏
設計師另外收了一大筆費用

items.promptZh: 這份合約的條款寫得太複雜了，我看不懂。
referenceEn: The terms of this contract are too convoluted for me to understand.
This contract is so convoluted that I can't understand it.
rubricZh: 「複雜難懂的」用 convoluted，位置例如 be 動詞後、名詞前（convoluted terms）等
「太⋯看不懂」可寫，例如 too…for me to understand、so…that I can't understand it 等
「條款」可寫，例如 terms、the wording 等，只說 this contract 也可以

items.promptZh: 這間咖啡館的布置很溫馨，就像朋友家的客廳。
referenceEn: This cafe has a homely feel, like a friend's living room.
The cafe is decorated in a homely style, just like a friend's living room.
rubricZh: 「溫馨」用 homely（例如 a homely feel、a homely style 等）
「就像」可寫，例如 like、just like 等
